completion_decisions: The target package is the six-case Gaussian wake problem plus MI-LXPM, not the paper's comparison baselines.
No target-paper author source or numeric archive was located; the implementation is independently reconstructed from the primary paper and two direct predecessors.
The PDF vector geometry supplies the 36x3 Fig. 6 wind probabilities at its displayed 0.001 precision; their 1.002 rounded total is retained without silent renormalization.
The reconstructed Fig. 6 no-wake power closes within 0.01% of the independent Table-4 power/efficiency identity.

The target paper's best-individual-survival statement takes precedence over the predecessor's complete-replacement step; the missing survival count is completed as a declared five-percent OPTIMTOOL-style setting.
All systematic tournaments, crossover, mutation and population evaluations use the persistent C++ team; precomputed Gaussian tables remove repeated transcendental work.
Thirty paper-native case/repeat runs are the Waffle outer full-resource axis and consume twenty CPU cores without nested oversubscription.

MI-LXPM operator parameters and elite count in the target paper
strict versus non-strict interpretation at exactly five rotor diameters
wake behavior below the stated three-diameter model-validity threshold

paper.authors: Leandro Parada and Carlos Herrera and Paulo Flores and Vı́ctor Parada
paper.title: Wind farm layout optimization using a Gaussian-based wake model

paper_source_conflicts: Fig. 6 exposes rounded vector bars but no numeric array.
The earlier T01 case-C asset gives about half the no-wake power required by L0124 Table 4 and is not reused.
The target paper says ranked best individuals survive; the cited MI-LXPM predecessor specifies complete generational replacement.
The target paper omits MI-LXPM operator values and its elite count.
The proximity inequality and the below-three-diameter model behavior are not operationally complete.

scope.claim_boundary: academic declared reproduction of the six paper problems, equations and predecessor-completed MI-LXPM; not author-source, author-random-state or exact-layout replay

constraints_and_repair.authority: target paper Eq. 13 plus declared boundary completion
constraints_and_repair.resolution: all turbine pairs must be at least five rotor diameters apart; no feasibility repair is inserted

decision_variables.resolution: 60 or 78 integer x/y grid coordinates for 30 or 39 turbines

encoding_and_decoder.resolution: direct ordered turbine coordinates mapped to 10x10 or 20x20 candidate cells

initialization.resolution: uniform integer coordinates in the grid bounds, counter-keyed by seed and individual

metrics_and_repeats.resolution: fitness, expected power and efficiency for five independent runs on every grid/case combination

objective_and_direction.resolution: minimize fixed-count farm cost divided by expected farm power

paper_native_cases.resolution: cases A, B and C on both 10x10 and 20x20 grids in a 2 km square

parameters.authority: target paper plus cited MI-LXPM and Gaussian predecessors
parameters.resolution: D=40 m, hub=60 m, Ct=0.88, k*=0.055, Pc=0.8, Pm=0.005, Laplace b_int=0.35, power p_int=4, population=600

stopping_and_physical_fes.resolution: 500 generations, 600 individuals and 300600 counted physical evaluations including initialization

update_order.authority: target paper plus cited predecessor and declared survival completion
update_order.resolution: systematic tournament, Laplace crossover, power mutation, five-percent elite survival, then complete population evaluation

wake_power_cost_or_coupled_model.authority: target paper Eqs. 1-10 and Gaussian predecessor
wake_power_cost_or_coupled_model.resolution: Gaussian deficit from three diameters, RSS wake combination, cubic power and fixed-count cost

wind_and_scenario_sampling.authority: target paper cases and vector Fig. 6
wind_and_scenario_sampling.resolution: case A one north 12 m/s state; case B 36 equal directions at 12 m/s; case C vector-digitized 36x3 joint distribution at 8, 12 and 17 m/s
